name: cadence
description: A Claude Code plugin that brings engineering practices to software you'll keep running after the session ends. It writes a plan before code, commits once per task, holds tests to a stopping rule, and checks the result against your goal. Its records live in your repository, so a new session picks up where the last one stopped.
